C-PLANS-LIFECYCLE-DESKTOP-252-V5.Summary: Replace the hidden plan lifecycle dropdown with a persistent desktop `Текущие | Архив` segmented control.
C-PLANS-LIFECYCLE-DESKTOP-252-V5.Problem: The primary active/archive register mode is hidden inside a generic select, requiring an unnecessary menu open for every switch.

Goals.Goal: Expose active and archived plans as one permanently visible desktop control.
Reuse the existing server-side `status=active|archived` query and lifecycle state authority.
Preserve search and ordinary filters while preventing stale detail after a mode switch.
Provide explicit keyboard, focus and empty states without decorative motion.

Constraints.Constraint: The branch is created from the exact current main ref before any governed write.
No API, SQLite schema, migration, plan lifecycle, archive/restore command, source-row decision, evidence or document-intake change.
No mobile-specific mode, navigation, bottom sheet, gesture or mobile-only transition is designed or implemented; unrelated responsive code remains untouched.
Lifecycle view is never-learn: statistics cannot select, reorder or reposition the modes.
No CDN, cloud, Docker, Internet or LLM dependency is added.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Redesign plan detail or source rows.
Implement reversible exclusion of extracted rows.
Rewrite general plan documentation in this micro-iteration.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `Текущие | Архив` is permanently visible in the desktop plans toolbar and changes the register with one click, Enter, Space, Home, End or horizontal arrow key.
The legacy lifecycle select is removed from visual and accessibility navigation but remains an internal compatibility bridge to the existing controller.
The visible control uses tablist/tab semantics, correct aria-selected state, roving tabindex, visible focus and a minimum 44 pixel hit area.
The existing server `status=active|archived` parameter remains authoritative; the adapter does not filter a combined client-side list.
Search and ordinary filters survive switching; a selected plan absent from the returned set cannot remain in detail.
Empty active and archive results use distinct operator text.
No mobile-specific feature or acceptance path is introduced; existing unrelated narrow-window layout is not modified.
State changes remain complete without animation and under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Focused tests, desktop Playwright, full project CI and GRACE final pass on one exact head before squash merge, post-merge CI and terminal archive.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The exact branch head proves one-action desktop lifecycle navigation through the existing status query with no data-contract, mobile-mode or unrelated documentation change.
